reply_text:
I can't promise to remember this. I don't have a way to save notes between conversations, and I can't write to your notes folder either. Your message does stay in our DM history, so if you ask me about the Tansleigh Packaging cutoff here later, I can look back and find 21 October. In another channel, or once this message is too far back, I may not find it.

I haven't changed anything. If you want something more reliable, I can put a calendar reminder for 21 October on your calendar. Just say so.
